| mold_v1-006 | P2 | to do | Write the operator runbook (brief to live app) |
| mold_v1-008 | P2 | blocked | Workspace export to CSV |
| mold_v1-007 | P3 | to do | Responsiveness lane: add a 320 px viewport |

Should I mark 005 as in progress and start it, or work on 004 or 006 first?
